system.name: James Monroe’s Highland
system.area: James Monroe Parkway, southeast of Charlottesville
system.description: Highland’s Rustic Trails cross woods and pastures beside James Monroe’s historic home. Choose gentle pasture loops or the steeper Mountain Trail; use the official map to plan your walk.

info_sources.label: Highland trail hours and visitor information

visitor_info.label: Hours
visitor_info.value: Daily, 9:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m., weather permitting; no trail entry after 3:30 p.m. Closed Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day and New Year’s Day.

visitor_info.label: Admission
visitor_info.value: Trails are free; check in at the Museum Shop on arrival. Tickets are required for the historic core.

visitor_info.label: Dogs
visitor_info.value: No pets except on designated Dog Days; service animals are welcome. Check Highland’s events calendar for Dog Days.

visitor_info.label: Trail use
visitor_info.value: No bicycles, horses or motorized vehicles. Stay on marked trails and respect private property.

visitor_info.label: Wet weather
visitor_info.value: Highland asks visitors to wait 24 hours for each inch of rainfall before using the trails. Bring drinking water; none is available on the trails.
